messages:
michael: Quick heads-up — partial GPU shipment confirmed for next Tue (ETA 09:30). Need clear owners for rack install, PDUs, and reservation mapping so we can open slots in the scheduler. Anyone taking lead?

sara: I can own rack install + PDUs for that wave. Will need rack unit list from @infra-team by Monday EOD.

jordan: I’ll do reservation mapping in the capacity matrix and update the spreadsheet. ping me the serials after install.

ashley: FYI procurement-bot shows 12 units arrived at the facility in manifest #PM-4829. Not all tested yet. :eyes:

procurement-bot: Manifest PM-4829: 12 GPUs logged, 8 in QC, 4 pending diagnostics. ETA QC completion: Mon 18:00.

michael: @sara thanks. @jordan I’ll drop the serial list once infra confirms after QC. Can you also pre-create two reservation groups: "dedicated-canary" (4 nodes) and "dedicated-burst" (6 nodes)? We can leave 2 unreserved as buffer.

jordan: Yep — will create groups. Quick question: do we pin model versions for the canary or let runtime pick latest quantized build?

taylor: For canary we should pin to quantized-v2.0 to stabilize perf numbers. Runtime canary should route to fallback-v1 for any perf regressions.

ashley: One blocker: power team flagged missing PDUs for Rack 14. @infra-team can we confirm PDU shipment and lead time?

infra-team: PDU backlog expected to clear Mon 12:00. We can stage a temporary inline power strip to complete basic smoke tests if needed. Recommend final PDU for production before enabling reservations.

michael: Plan: Sara to do install + temporary strips for smoke on Tue morning, infra to swap in final PDUs Mon if they arrive. Jordan to create reservation groups and mark tentative slots. I’ll coordinate canary config with runtime team.

sara: Sounds good. I’ll post a short install checklist after I confirm rack-unit mapping.

jordan: Done — created groups and tentative slot IDs in the capacity sheet: https://redwood.internal/capacity/sheet#PM-4829. Marked buffer nodes as free.

michael: Two ask items before Tue: 1) infra confirm final PDU ETA (assign a ticket), 2) procurement confirm QC completion and share serials. If both green we flip reservations to active post-smoke.

procurement-bot: QC updated: PM-4829 diagnostics complete at 17:52. Serial list attached to ticket PRQ-9081.

infra-team: PDUs shipped overnight, tracking #UPS-77321. ETA to datacenter Mon 10:30. Opening ticket INF-7219 for install coordination.

michael: Great. If nothing else, we’ll meet async here Monday 11:00 for final go/no-go. Can folks react with :thumbsup: when they confirm their ownership?

sara: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

taylor: :thumbsup:

michael: Awesome — thanks everyone. I’ll post a short post-install checklist and update the rollout playbook (canary -> burst -> open).
